owner_order: Jamar, 2026-10-28: all Lustre versions need any baked shadow on the feet removed; shadowed originals marked obsolete; cleaned versions marked as the current/used ones.
rule: No baked shadows in character art (shadows are added at composite time). Cleaned file = <stem>-clean-20261028.png beside the original; the cleaned file is CURRENT/used, the shadowed original is OBSOLETE for art use. Originals are kept (checkpoint law — nothing deleted).
method: Every one of the 1,246 lustre images was opened and inspected. Sprites: per-family shadow masks fitted on measured pixel maps and proofed before/after on white and dark backgrounds; variant files of a family share pixel-identical alpha, so each family's validated base mask was applied to the whole family and the result re-audited (residual counts uniform per family). Kept pixels are byte-identical to the originals — only shadow pixels were made transparent (18,562 px across 163 files).
